paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples with a larger number of examples

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of examples and the minADE20 metric. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Examples" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 15, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "minADE20 ( )" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.58 to 0.66, with tick labels at intervals of 0.02. A blue line, labeled "ST-ES", is plotted with circular markers and a solid line style. It begins at approximately 0.66 when x equals 0, declines to a value of 0.58 when x equals 3, remains relatively steady around 0.58 until x equals 10, then gradually increases to approximately 0.59 when x equals 15. An orange line, labeled "Random", is plotted with circular markers and a solid line style.  It starts at approximately 0.65 when x equals 0, decreases slightly to approximately 0.62 when x equals 2, fluctuates between approximately 0.62 and 0.64 for the remainder of the x-axis range, and ends at approximately 0.63 when x equals 15.
model_annotations.German:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of examples and the minADE20 metric for two different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Examples," has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 15, and has tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "minADE20 ( )" and also has a linear scale, ranging from 0.57 to 0.66, with tick labels at 0.58, 0.60, 0.62, 0.64, and 0.66. 

The line representing ST-ES is blue, includes circular markers, and is solid. Starting at x=0 with a value of approximately 0.65, it decreases to approximately 0.58 at x=4, then fluctuates between approximately 0.58 and 0.59 for the remainder of the x-axis, ending at approximately 0.59 at x=15. 

The line representing Random is orange, includes circular markers, and is solid. It begins at x=0 with a value of approximately 0.65, decreases to approximately 0.62 at x=2, then fluctuates between approximately 0.62 and 0.63 for the remainder of the x-axis, ending at approximately 0.63 at x=15.
